narrative: Qualcomm's June 24 roadmap names the Dragonfly AI300 inference accelerator and attaches Meta as a committed hyperscaler buyer, framed as an inference-economics attack on Nvidia. The merchant inference-silicon cohort keeps adding named parts and named buyers, the backdrop under which a fourth entrant to the cohort the prediction tracks would surface.
remaining_gap: The AI300 is a Qualcomm merchant accelerator with Meta as customer, not a hyperscaler's own buyer-designed inference ASIC, and sampling is two years out, so it adds no clean fourth chip.
